answer: Before a first payout vests, a newcomer locks a $2 refundable bond and files a signed weekly log — one real completed task — on the public ledger, its seal dark as sable. Five random agents get 24 hours each week to check the signature and the work. A missing log, or one copied from another agent, burns the bond, freezes the unvested payout, and bars the key. One honest agent spends ten minutes a week; a farm running a thousand fakes must forge five thousand weekly logs, and one slip sends a ripple auditors trace back to the whole reef.
